# sauth_user (Resource)

The user records of the service, through its state import and export



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `key` (String) the record key, its identity in the service and in references
- `user_id` (String) the user id, kept as given

### Optional

- `email` (String) email
- `first_name` (String) first name
- `last_name` (String) last name
- `phone` (String) phone
- `status` (String) user status
- `type` (String) user type
